zh.title: 星宇航空開航台北—峇里島　每週 5 班拓展印尼航網
zh.summary: 星宇航空於 10 月 1 日開航台北—峇里島航線，峇里島成為其第二個印尼航點；官方先前公布以 A321neo 執飛，初期每週 5 班。
body: 星宇航空於 2026 年 10 月 1 日開航台北—峇里島航線。中央社當日報導確認首航，並指出峇里島是星宇在印尼的第二個航點，航線每週提供 5 班往返服務。
依星宇航空 4 月 8 日的官方航線規劃，台北—峇里島採 Airbus A321neo 執飛，開航初期每週 5 班。此次開航落實了當時公布的 10 月 1 日啟航日期。
官方班表列出的飛航日為週一、週二、週四、週五與週日。JX765 台北飛峇里島的表定時間為 10:10 至 15:40；JX766 峇里島飛台北為 17:20 至 22:50，均為當地時間。這些是表定時刻，航空公司提醒應以最新航班資訊為準。
星宇執行長翟健華向中央社表示，新航線也希望吸引歐美旅客經台北轉機前往峇里島。這項拓展印尼航網的安排，結合台灣出發客源與歐美至東南亞的轉機市場；轉機客需求與營運效益仍屬航空公司設定的目標。

en.title: STARLUX launches Taipei–Bali service with five weekly flights
en.summary: STARLUX inaugurated Taipei–Bali service on October 1, making Bali its second Indonesian destination. Its previously announced plan specifies A321neo aircraft and five weekly flights.
body: STARLUX Airlines inaugurated its Taipei–Bali route on October 1, 2026. Taiwan's Central News Agency reported the launch that day, identifying Bali as the carrier's second destination in Indonesia and confirming five weekly round trips.

STARLUX's official April 8 route announcement specified Airbus A321neo aircraft and five weekly flights during the initial operation. The launch follows the October 1 start date announced at that time.

The published operating days are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday. JX765 is scheduled to leave Taipei at 10:10 and arrive in Bali at 15:40; JX766 is scheduled from Bali at 17:20 to Taipei at 22:50. All times are local. These are scheduled times, and STARLUX advises passengers to check its latest flight information.

STARLUX's chief executive told CNA that the service also aims to attract European and North American passengers connecting through Taipei to Bali. The route therefore targets both Taiwan-origin travel and transfer traffic between those long-haul markets and Southeast Asia. Connecting demand and operating benefits remain the airline's stated objectives.

facts.claim: CNA published its launch report at 2026-10-01 12:37 Taiwan time (04:37 UTC), confirming STARLUX inaugurated Taipei–Bali on October 1, with five weekly flights and Bali as its second Indonesian destination.
STARLUX's April 8, 2026 announcement specified A321neo aircraft and five weekly flights initially from October 1.
The official timetable lists Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Sunday; JX765 TPE–DPS 10:10–15:40 and JX766 DPS–TPE 17:20–22:50, all local scheduled times, subject to the airline's latest updates.

CEO Glenn Chai told CNA the new service aims to attract European and North American travellers connecting via Taipei to Bali; these are commercial objectives rather than demonstrated traffic or financial results.
